laws.rule: standing and receipts bind the exact subject
consequence and value terms are finite and bounded
replay is non-actuating without a fresh consequence admission
the adversarial attempt must reach the intended boundary
a forbidden consequence may not be observed
consequential semantics are visible and canonically owned
capability evidence signature plan receipt semantic truth model output and external allow do not manufacture DO authority
generated projections bind canonical source generator and digest
inherited negative knowledge remains exact-subject bound
guard retirement requires same-subject evidence and a falsifier
external capability semantics enter as candidates and do not inherit local DO
negative net value cannot be promoted to ALIVE
every declared canonical owner is explicit
qualification requires at least one falsifier
